modelName: How the money moves and what makes it move
modelNote: One dollar's path from an employer to the people who do the work, and the three couplings that tie it to performance. The split (70/20/10) is a DIAL, not a recommendation — turning it up strengthens the signal and increases the incentive to select easy members and game the verification. Three guards sit under it: risk-adjusted order value against cherry-picking, the win-win statement to size the shared pot, and an SPC control chart to keep anyone from being paid against common-cause noise. Drawn Aug 16 2026. EXTENDED Aug 16 2026 with the public-health register: about a third of the savings returns to the NDCs as a place-order fund, which is what solves the wrong-pocket problem — the co-op captures the savings that better place conditions produce, and pays for those conditions out of them. A place order is verified by a GROUP of residents, never by an individual and never by a crowd. EXTENDED Aug 16 2026 with the CATALYTIC TEST — Marc's framing from facilitating a local foundation: a catalytic foundation changes the system so the need declines; a provider of consumables funds a need that returns next year, larger. Every stream on this drawing now carries its answer to that test as a visible tag, and the one honest exception — support that is consumable by design and should be — is drawn explicitly. REVISED Aug 16 2026: a place order funds the neighbourhood DOING something, not the co-op BUYING something. The residents' own work is what makes the group more capable of the next order, so the project and the capacity are not separable line items.

legendEntries.label: The gate — what performance has to show before this stream moves
A guard — stops the mechanism corrupting itself
the savings loop — better places, fewer acute orders

nodes.label: The split is a DIAL. Turn the at-risk share up and the signal gets stronger — and so does the incentive to pick easy members and to game the verification.
nodes.note: The percentages are illustrative. What is NOT a dial is the ordering: capacity must be the largest stream, or the model asks clinicians to gamble with their income and they will decline, correctly.

nodes.label: EMPLOYER PMPM
nodes.note: A per-member-per-month payment from each pooled employer. Same dollar they already spend — the change is who it is paid to and what it buys.

nodes.label: POOLED FUND
nodes.note: Held by the co-op as contracting agent, in a trust or TPA account. The co-op does not keep a margin on the flow; it is paid a transparent administration fee, which is the difference between a co-op and a carrier.

nodes.label: CAPACITY ~70%
nodes.note: Pays the ME to exist and be available for its panel — steady, monthly, predictable. This is the stream that lets a CHW team or a care pod hold an order without anyone becoming an entrepreneur. Buurtzorg's nurses are salaried; the self-management is in the work, not in the paycheque.  CATALYTIC TEST: Neither balancing nor reinforcing. An ME always needs to exist, so this never switches itself off — but it is not consumed either. It is the platform that makes every catalytic thing above it possible, and it is the reason nobody has to gamble with their income.
extraLabels: enabling · the floor the others stand on

props.loop_type: enabling · the floor the others stand on

nodes.label: ORDER ~20%
nodes.note: Attached to one named person's plan — the dan. A FLOOR is paid on delivery. The member's verification releases the remainder. Non-response settles at the floor, never at zero — so nobody has a reason to chase a signature, and no member can be pressured for one.  CATALYTIC TEST: The self-terminating shape. Access to what was needed increases the ability to manage, which reduces the need for the next order. Catalytic in Marc's sense.
extraLabels: balancing · switches itself off when the plan is met

props.loop_type: balancing · switches itself off when the plan is met

nodes.label: SHARED UPSIDE ~10%
nodes.note: The VAM — the wager. Agreed in advance against a LEADING target the ME can act on this week, never a lagging outcome it cannot move.  CATALYTIC TEST: Rewards improvement, which reduces future need — but between MEs it can compound advantage into Success to the Successful. Two conditions keep it balancing: the target must pass a control chart first, and the share must be equalised toward the weaker microcommunities.
extraLabels: balancing ONLY if the target is charted and the share equalised

props.loop_type: balancing ONLY if the target is charted and the share equalised

nodes.label: NO GATE — income is not a wager
nodes.note: Deliberate asymmetry. Two of the three streams are gated and this one never is, so that failure of the mechanism can never become failure to make payroll.

nodes.label: MEMBER VERIFIES
nodes.note: The named person confirms: met, partly met, or not met. Signed with their own key, on their own record — the SODOTO self-custody identity you already built. It RAISES payment above the floor; it never withholds it. Silence is neutral. The member may amend or revoke, and a random sample is checked by someone with no financial interest in the answer.

nodes.label: LEADING TARGET MET
nodes.note: Days from ask to plan. Percentage of members with a current plan. Follow-ups completed within 14 days. Things a team can move this week — not readmission rates, which are lagging, confounded, and too small-N at neighborhood scale.

nodes.label: TEAM PAYROLL
nodes.note: Steady income for the people doing the work.

nodes.label: PAID TO ALL THE TEAMS ON THIS PLAN
nodes.note: Paid to the microcommunity bound to this person — every ME that had to succeed for the plan to be met, together. Not to one ME, and never to one individual ranked against peers.

nodes.label: SHARED ACROSS ALL THE TEAMS
nodes.note: Shared, so no ME can win while the person's outcome fails. This is the answer to Deming's objection to incentive pay: the unit of reward is the microcommunity around one named person, not a ranked individual.

nodes.label: RISK-ADJUSTED ORDER VALUE
nodes.note: A harder plan carries more money, so grabbing the easy orders stops being the winning move. Without this, an open order book cherry-picks — the best-known failure mode of letting anyone bid. And an order nobody grabs goes back to the platform: that is a signal about pricing, never a judgement about the person.

nodes.label: WIN-WIN VALUE-ADDED STATEMENT
nodes.note: Haier's replacement for the P&L (共赢增值表). Counts ecosystem value — members served, resources drawn in, total cost trend against the county — and decides how big the shared pot is before it is divided. Nothing in health care has an analogue for this; it is the instrument you are most missing.

nodes.label: CHART IT BEFORE YOU PAY ON IT
nodes.note: A measure qualifies as a payment trigger only after it has been on a control chart long enough to show whether its movement is signal or common-cause noise. Paying against a stable process month to month is paying for randomness, and Deming showed exactly what that produces: tampering. This is the rational-subgroup discipline doing real structural work, not decoration.

nodes.label: CARE NEVER WAITS ON THE MONEY
nodes.note: No clinical decision is ever contingent on settlement state. The payment experiment runs BESIDE care, never in front of it. If the ledger is wrong, broken, or disputed, the care still happens and the argument happens afterwards. This rule outranks every other rule on this drawing.

nodes.label: THE SECOND REGISTER — PLACE ORDERS (PUBLIC HEALTH)
nodes.note: The public-health register. Same workbench, same co-op, different index: a place rather than a person, verified by a group rather than an individual, funded from savings rather than premium.

nodes.label: SAVINGS AT YEAR END
nodes.note: What the pool did not have to spend, because members were healthier. In every other arrangement this is captured by whoever holds the premium and disappears. Here it is the funding source for the thing that produced it.  CATALYTIC TEST: The finding this diagram nearly missed. Savings arise against EXPECTED cost. Risk-adjust the expectation and money flows toward the neighbourhoods with the most headroom, which are the sickest — balancing. Fail to risk-adjust and the healthiest neighbourhoods look most efficient and collect the most, which is reinforcing and compounds exactly the inequality the design exists to reduce. Risk adjustment is therefore structural, not a fairness nicety.
extraLabels: balancing ONLY if expected cost is risk-adjusted

props.loop_type: balancing ONLY if expected cost is risk-adjusted

nodes.label: ~1/3 TO THE NDCs
nodes.note: The savings share. This is the mechanism that solves the wrong-pocket problem: normally the entity that pays for prevention never captures the savings, so prevention never gets funded. The co-op captures them and sends a third back to the neighborhoods that produced them.  CATALYTIC TEST: The form matters as much as the amount. A recurring share that funds convening, crews, tools and conditions is catalytic. The same money as a single large settlement to an entity builds a political economy around itself — see WHY NOT A LUMP SUM.
extraLabels: recurring and capability-shaped · never a settlement

props.loop_type: recurring and capability-shaped · never a settlement

nodes.label: PLACE ORDER
nodes.note: The dan for public health: a named condition in a named place. Not 'reduce obesity in the county' — an aggregate nobody can own or verify. 'This block has no safe crossing to the school.' Concrete, singular, and it already has an address: the Issue Polygon Map gives every polygon a URL.  CATALYTIC TEST: A crossing built stays built. The clearest catalytic spend in the whole design, and the reason place orders are worth the machinery.  DOING, NOT BUYING: this funds the neighbourhood doing something, not the co-op procuring an outcome. The distinction is not the amount, it is whether the unit of funding is a collective project or a transaction. And because group skill is made in the act of associating, the doing IS the capacity-building — the project and the capability are not two line items. Test: if a contractor could execute it faster and better, the order was specified as a purchase and should be re-cut.

nodes.label: NEIGHBOURHOOD CREW
nodes.note: Not a clinical team. An NDC crew, a block association, a CHW team, a public works crew — whoever can actually change the condition. They grab the place order the same way a care pod grabs a person order.  The crew is residents plus whatever skill they need alongside them, not a vendor arriving to install something while the neighbourhood watches. Money buys materials, tools and accompaniment; the labour is the group's own, and doing it together is what produces the belonging that makes the next verification honest.

nodes.label: THE GROUP VERIFIES
nodes.note: A quorum of residents inside the polygon, each signing with their own key. Not a community representative — that is how this gets captured. Eleven of the nineteen households on this block, signing independently, is verification; one person speaking for the block is not.

nodes.label: PAID TO THE NEIGHBOURHOOD MICROCOMMUNITY
nodes.note: Paid to the microcommunity that held the place order — the crews and the NDC together, never to one body.

nodes.label: PUBLIC HEALTH CAPACITY — NOT AN ORDER
nodes.note: Surveillance, outbreak response, inspection, enforcement, preparedness. Standing capacity you need before you know what for; some of it adversarial, so the inspected party's verification can never release payment; and its success is permanently invisible. Fund it unconditionally or it will be starved by the parts that verify nicely. In acute care the capacity stream is about 70%. In public health it is nearly all of it, and the order layer sits on top for discrete, place-named improvements only.  CATALYTIC TEST: Surveillance and enforcement must not switch off when things are going well — that is precisely when they look unnecessary and get cut, which is how the next outbreak is paid for.

nodes.label: THE CATALYTIC TEST

props.question: Does receiving this reduce the need for it, or increase it?

nodes.note: Marc's distinction from facilitating a new local foundation: a CATALYTIC foundation changes the system so the need declines; a PROVIDER OF CONSUMABLES funds a need that comes back next year, larger. Applied to money, the test is structural rather than moral — a balancing loop switches itself off, a reinforcing loop feeds the engine that produced the need. Ask it of every arrow on this drawing. Note that it is a test, not a verdict: see PERPETUAL SUPPORT for the case where consumable is the right answer.

nodes.label: WHY NOT A LUMP SUM
nodes.note: Stated in its defensible form. The objection is NOT that recipients of cash misuse it — the unconditional transfer evidence runs the other way, and people generally know their own needs better than a provider does. The objection is that large, concentrated, one-time settlements create a political economy around themselves: administration, intermediaries, brokers, and capture. Corruption sits inside that loop in the Repairing Reparations diagram, and it is the mechanism that turns a repair into a new extraction. So: recurring and capability-shaped to a neighbourhood, not a single large settlement to an entity.

nodes.label: PLANS THAT NEVER CLOSE
extraLabels: consumable by design · and that is right
nodes.note: Some damage is not repaired by access. Brain, body and emotional injury can leave someone permanently unable to support themselves, and for them the balancing loop never reaches zero — the Repairing Reparations diagram is honest about this and our design was not. These plans are carried entirely by the capacity stream: no verification gate, no order payment, and NO IMPLICATION OF FAILURE when the plan does not close. Without this category the mechanism quietly penalises the most damaged people for not getting better, and it would do so while looking efficient.

nodes.label: FUND THE GROUP'S DOING — NOT THE INDIVIDUAL'S ACT
nodes.note: Both halves matter. Paying one neighbour per check-in is a piece rate on a commons and destroys the reciprocity that made it work — that is crowding out. Funding a group to build the crossing together is the opposite. The unit of funding must be a collective project, never a transaction with an individual. And if the thing being funded could just as well be bought from a vendor, it is not a place order; it is procurement, and it builds no capacity.

edges.label: floor — settles anyway if the member says nothing
edges.note: The bypass IS the safety device. Without it, withholding money for a missing signature turns every ME into a collections agent pointed at a sick person.
